name: Ts’ui Hu
bio: Ts’ui Hu is dated by Giles to the 8th or 9th century AD. His poem here recalls a spring encounter.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Retrospect
poems.author: Ts’ui Hu
poems.text:
Oh this day last year what a party were we
Pink cheeks and pink peach-blossoms smiled upon me;
But alas the pink cheeks are now far far away,
Though the peach-blossoms smile as they smiled on that day.
